provider_name.description: Configured OAuth provider name used to build a legacy display fallback.

display_name.description: Resolved operator-facing name. A configured account label takes precedence; legacy rows use the provider name plus a stable short account reference so multiple accounts remain distinguishable.

refresh_token_updated_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp when the stored OAuth refresh token was first registered or replaced. Legacy accounts without recorded history return an empty string.

access_token_refreshed_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp when the short-lived OAuth access token was last refreshed automatically. The access token itself is never returned or persisted.
